newsitem.title: USA: US late spot distillates gain, gasoline diffs jump.
newsitem.headline: US late spot distillates gain, gasoline diffs jump.

text.p: U.S. spot distillate prices scored sharp gains late Wednesday with NYMEX, while tight gasoline supplies and news of heavy Tosco buying in New York firmed differentials enough to mostly offset lower gasoline futures, traders said.

Differentials on New York Harbor conventional unleaded M4-grade gasoline firmed 0.90 cent to about 2.60 cents over December futures, players said, in part because of news that Tosco had bought 500,000 barrels of NYH gasoline mid afternoon.
"It's surprising because they're the largest producer of gasoline on the East Coast and they're usually not a net buyer," one trader said.

Traders debated whether Tosco was buying the barrels to satisfy an exchange agreement with another refiner or whether the purchases -- reportedly 300,000 barrels of conventional unleaded and 200,000 of reformulated -- indicated problems at Tosco's giant Bayway refinery in New Jersey.
Tosco, citing company policy, declined to comment.
New York A5-reformulated saw diffs firm a half cent to 3.25 cents over the print, players said.
